text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Dedicated pool 'valora-vpc-prod' (tenant=valora-health) GPU saturation hit 95% sustained for 10m. backlog=340, active=52/52. Paging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Ack. Ana (SRE) & Ravi (infra) please jump in. Staging a triage channel here.

Ana: Oncall Ana here. Pulling metrics and traces. Initial question: is this a spike from a single client session or broad traffic?

Jules: I have session traces. ~4% of sessions are long-context (7-12k tokens) and are pinning KV caches and GPUs. Many of those originate from valora-health beta endpoints.

support-valora: Valora ops confirms they rolled a beta that streams long patient summaries starting ~12m ago. They did not intend to hit production pool at full concurrency. We're initiating an internal rollback now but need mitigation to avoid customer SLA breach.

ops-bot: Dedicated pool policy: soft_burst=2 GPUs auto, hard_burst=8 GPUs manual approval. Autoscaler=disabled for reserved pools. Current_burst=0.

Ana: We need immediate relief: options: 1) enforce per-endpoint concurrency cap for valora-health, 2) preempt low-priority/background pods in pool, 3) spill a fraction of requests to hosted fallback, 4) request manual burst +5 GPUs. I propose 1+2+3 now, submit 4 as backup.

Ravi: I'll run selective preemption for pods labelled "batch" and "demo-load" and drop their priority. Also will prepare allocation request if burst approved.

Ana: Implementing quick concurrency cap for /v1/patient_summary: concurrency=1 per-session, ttl=45s.

Ana: ```
PATCH /internal/rls/tenants/valora-health
{ "endpoint": "/v1/patient_summary", "max_concurrency": 1, "window": "45s", "scope": "tenant" }
```

ops-bot: Rate-limit rule applied.

Ravi: Preempting batch/demo pods:
```
/dedicated preempt --pool valora-vpc-prod --selector "role in (batch,demo)" --grace 10s
```

ops-bot: Preempt command accepted. 9 pods marked for preemption; draining.

Ana: Also setting a temporary spillover: 30% of low-priority inference to hosted/gpt-small-hosted. This will reduce KV contention while keeping high-priority paths local.

Ana: ```
POST /internal/routes/valora-vpc-prod/fallback
{ "scope": "low_priority", "model": "redwood/gpt-small-hosted", "weight": 0.3 }
```

ops-bot: Route rollout scheduled: 60s progressive.

incident-bot: Manual approval required for burst >2 GPUs. To approve post APPROVE-BURST <pool> <#gpus> by eng-manager or SRE-manager.

Ana: Requesting manual burst as contingency: REQUEST-BURST valora-vpc-prod +5 (reason: customer-facing latency and backlog growth).

eng-manager-ana: I'm Ana (eng-manager) and can approve up to +6 for emergencies. APPROVE-BURST valora-vpc-prod +5 (approved - urgency high).

incident-bot: Approval recorded (eng-manager-ana). Allocating resources...

ops-bot: Allocation issued: /pool allocate --name valora-vpc-prod --gpus +5 --mode ephemeral --ttl 45m -> IN PROGRESS.

ops-bot: Allocation success. New workers=57, estimated gpu_util=80% after warmup.

Jules: Post-allocation metrics: backlog decreased from 340 -> 78 within 3m. p50 latency reduced from 450ms -> 170ms. Long-tail sessions still ~2.6s but system throughput back to normal. KV eviction pressure dropping.

support-valora: Confirmed on their side: customer-facing errors dropping to zero. Valora will pause the beta rollout for 1h.

Ana: Current mitigation status: rate-limit applied, preempted 9 pods, fallback 30% active, burst +5 active (ttl 44:20). Monitoring closely for 25m to ensure stability.

Ravi: Captured debug traces and perf profiles for root cause. Will add them to incident doc. Also started infra task to warm standby nodes for future rapid bursts.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: impact reduced; error-rate normal for 8m. Keep thread open until burst TTL or we downscale safely.

Ana: Handoff and next actions: I'll own postmortem and runbook updates. Ravi will own infra follow-ups (standby warm nodes, faster burst path). Jules will attach trace samples and suggest telemetry changes (per-tenant seq_len histogram). Support-valora to coordinate customer comms. Handoff: Ana -> Ravi at 12:30 UTC for monitoring.

eng-manager-ana: Good call. Post-incident actions to propose: 1) opt-in autoscaler for dedicated pools with enterprise SLA, 2) per-tenant max_seq_len enforcement with graceful 413/short-circuit, 3) pre-approved burst tiers per-account to avoid manual approvals, 4) better per-pool priority eviction policies.

Ravi: Noted. I'll open infra tickets and tag priority P0 for warm-standby work.

Jules: Saved traces and session samples. Will redact PHI before attaching to postmortem.

support-valora: Thank you for the rapid help. We'll send a confirmation to Valora ops when rollback completes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation successful - entering monitoring. Keep thread active until TTL expires and metrics stable for 30m.

Ana: I'll publish postmortem draft in 24h and schedule a follow-up with product + account teams. Closing handoff to Ravi for watch.

Ravi: Confirmed watch. Will escalate if any regression.

incident-bot: Thread will remain active. Last recorded state: pool_util=63%, backlog=12, pending=1, fallback=0.3, burst=+5 (ttl=00:42:10).
